prompt: Qaysi so'z mantiqan to'g'ri keladi? "The scientist was cautious, refusing to draw conclusions until every result was ___."
explanation_uz: "Cautious" (ehtiyotkor) olim natijalar tekshirilmaguncha xulosa qilmaydi: "verified" — tekshirilgan.

prompt:
Matnni o'qing va savolga javob bering.

When the town of Brenning opened a community garden, organizers expected most volunteers to be retirees with free time. Instead, the sign-up sheets showed that many volunteers were parents who came with their children on weekend mornings. The organizers have since added a children's planting area and moved most workshops to Saturdays.

Matnga ko'ra, tashkilotchilar nima uchun bog' ishini o'zgartirdi?
choices: Retirees asked for workshops to be moved to weekends.
The volunteers turned out to be different from the group the organizers had expected.
The town required every garden to include a children's area.
Too few people signed up to volunteer on weekday mornings.
explanation_uz: Tashkilotchilar ko'ngillilar asosan nafaqaxo'rlar bo'ladi deb kutgan, ro'yxatda esa ko'pchilik bolasi bilan kelgan ota-onalar chiqqan. Bolalar maydonchasi va shanba kungi mashg'ulotlar shu kutilmagan holatga javob. A, C va D variantlarda aytilgan narsa matnda yo'q, javob esa faqat matndagi dalilga tayanadi.

prompt: Qaysi variant gapni to'g'ri yakunlaydi? "The library opened in ___ has served the town ever since."
explanation_uz: Ikki mustaqil gap vergul va "and" bilan bog'lanadi: "1998, and it". Faqat vergul qo'yish (C) xato hisoblanadi.

prompt:
Qaysi variant gapni to'g'ri yakunlaydi?

"Each of the students in the robotics club ___ responsible for building one part of the final machine."
explanation_uz: Ega "Each" (har biri) birlikda. "of the students" uni faqat aniqlaydi, shuning uchun fe'l ham birlikda bo'ladi: "is". "are", "were" va "have been" ko'plik shakllari: ular yaqin turgan "students" so'ziga moslashtirilgan, ega esa u emas.

prompt:
Qaysi o'tish so'zi matnni mantiqan to'g'ri bog'laydi?

Many desert plants survive long dry periods by storing water in their stems. The saguaro cactus, ___ has a pleated trunk that expands like an accordion as it fills with water after a rain.
explanation_uz: Birinchi gapda umumiy fikr bor: ko'p cho'l o'simliklari suvni poyasida saqlaydi. Ikkinchi gap saguaro kaktusini shu fikrga misol qilib keltiradi, shuning uchun "for example" mos keladi. "However" va "in contrast" qarama-qarshilikni, "instead" esa bir narsa o'rniga boshqasini bildiradi. Ikkinchi gap birinchisiga zid emas.

prompt: Agar 3x + 5 = 20 bo'lsa, x ning qiymati nechaga teng?
explanation_uz: Ikki tomondan 5 ni ayiramiz: 3x = 15. Keyin 3 ga bo'lamiz: x = 5. Tekshirish: 3 · 5 + 5 = 20.
desmos_tip: Desmos'da y = 3x + 5 va y = 20 ni alohida qatorlarga yozing. Javob chiziqlar kesishgan nuqtaning x koordinatasi.
Desmos'da birinchi qatorga f(x) = 2x - 1, ikkinchi qatorga f(4) deb yozing: qiymat shu yerda chiqadi.

prompt: x² = 49 va x > 0 bo'lsa, x nechaga teng?
explanation_uz: x² = 49 tenglamaning ildizlari 7 va −7. Shart bo'yicha x > 0, demak x = 7.
desmos_tip: Desmos'da y = x^2 va y = 49 ni yozing: ikkita kesishish nuqtasi chiqadi. Shart x > 0 bo'lgani uchun musbatini oling.

prompt: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning katetlari 5 va 12 ga teng. Gipotenuzasi nechaga teng?
explanation_uz: Pifagor teoremasi: c² = 5² + 12² = 25 + 144 = 169, demak c = √169 = 13. 17 katetlar yig'indisi, 30 uchburchak yuzi, 169 esa ildizi olinmagan c².
